messages.subject: Re: Penalties
parts:
Karl:
 
Previously I did obtain the 5% thresholds=c(6.47, 4.83, 4.25, 4.92, 2.62) and the 10% thresholds=c(5.95, 4.46, 3.89, 4.38, 2.34) for a RIL population of wheat using > operm2.imp <- scantwo(data, method="imp", n.perm=1000). Unfortunately I didn't derive the "penalties" at that time. Now that I'm interested to check the automated model selection procedure, and would like to derive the "penalties" first, is there a way to derive the penalties just by using the above thresholds without going all over again through the time consuming 1000 permutations?
 
Thanks
 
Peter

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Penalties
parts:
Here's a bit of code:

calc.pen.alt <- function(qu) {
# penalties <- c(qu[["one"]], qu[["int"]], qu[["fv1"]]-qu[["one"]])
c(qu[[5]], qu[[3]], qu[[2]]-qu[[5]])
}

thr05 <- c(6.47, 4.83, 4.25, 4.92, 2.62)
thr10 <- c(5.95, 4.46, 3.89, 4.38, 2.34)

print(pen05 <- calc.pen.alt(thr05))
# 2.62 4.25 2.21

print(pen10 <- calc.pen.alt(thr10))
# 2.34 3.89 2.12

karl
